status: IMMUTABLE — any change requires experiment_plan_v2.json; this file must not be overwritten
research_question: Does L1 quote dynamics predict a directional markout at 5s-5min, and does that gross edge survive the real round-trip cost, OOS, bootstrap and FDR?
primary_dataset_rule: read the immutable snapshot ONLY; live_fxtm must never be read by any experiment in this task
horizon_note: 50ms/200ms/1s/2s are COST_BLOCKED and appear as REFERENCE_ONLY only; they are excluded from alpha selection

labels.MID_MARKOUT: LONG: future_mid - entry_mid ; SHORT: entry_mid - future_mid
labels.EXECUTION_MARKOUT: LONG: future_mid - ask(t) ; SHORT: bid(t) - future_mid
labels.censoring: HORIZON_CENSORED samples excluded, never set to 0

split_rule: chronological by UTC day; NO random/shuffle split
purge: == horizon (train samples whose forward window reaches VAL are dropped; likewise VAL->TEST)
embargo: == horizon (carried by the same purge rule)
model_selection_fold: VALIDATION only; TEST is evaluated once at the end

statistical_tests.primary: two-sided t-test on NON-OVERLAPPING net edges (iid t-test alone is forbidden)
statistical_tests.effective_n_rule: effective_n = n // max(1, round(rho)), rho = h / median_inter_tick_ms

multiple_testing_method.family: all feature-family x horizon x model screen tests on VAL
multiple_testing_method.reporting: report total_tests, valid_tests, insufficient_tests, significant_tests separately

cost_stress.rule: robustness only; features are NOT reselected after stress

tail_analysis.TAIL_DEPENDENT_if: mean > 0 and median <= 0 and top10pct_share dominates

alpha_acceptance_conditions: 4 block bootstrap CI not entirely below 0
